Unmodified Wayback replay bytes (Shift_JIS, emergency=true). CPython's expat-based xml.etree cannot decode a multi-byte encoding declared in the XML prolog, so feeding these exact bytes to the provider raises ParseError; see KEIO.md.

Synthetic transcoding of the same real capture: decoded as Shift_JIS then re-encoded as UTF-8 (prolog's encoding attribute updated to match); no character, tag, or value was changed. Used only to exercise the current UTF-8-era parser against this real incident's text, since the original bytes are not decodable by xml.etree.
